name: fluidvoice.best-asr
notes: Maintainer-recommended local ASR for accuracy: FluidVoice's model list rates Whisper Large and Qwen3 ASR 1.7B highest (accuracyPercent 1.00, above Cohere Transcribe 0.98); Whisper Large is the one it describes as 'Best possible accuracy' and comes first in its list. Cleanup off.
verify: Verify on the host (16 GB): FluidVoice needs 8 GB of free memory to load Whisper Large (the 8 GB VM refuses and deletes it). Download it in Settings > Voice Engine (setup waits and restarts FluidVoice), check the language (English or auto), then add ~/Library/Caches/WhisperModels/whisper-large-v3-Q8_0.gguf (1668741440 bytes, sha256 2fa1a5f179f8a511a53e2108db270aa4af3ce08cd976af4180e2854666bb4ba3) to model.files.
